name: City Knights
description: City Knights, formally known as Insane Gangster City Knights (IGCKs), are a street gang originating from the Back of the Yards neighborhood on Chicago's South Side. Founded in 1980 by a member known as Bubba near 48th and Wood Street, the group began as a party crew before developing into a full gang. In 1989 they joined the Insane (South Side) faction of Folk Nation — an alliance led by the Satan Disciples — and adopted the 'Insane Gangster' prefix, making them the only other Chicago gang besides the Satan Disciples to carry both designations. The gang is primarily Latino and has been involved in conflicts with Two Six, Latin Souls, Ambrose, and other South Side gangs.
